### Master Directory Structure

```
ws/
├── index.html                          # Entry point — loads /src/main.ts
├── package.json                        # Vite + Three.js deps
├── vite.config.ts                      # Alias: @shared → src/shared/, @game → src/game/<name>/
├── tsconfig.json                       # Strict mode, paths mapping
│
├── shared/                             # Reusable across all games in the collection
│   ├── types.ts                        # Core type definitions (Vec3, Quat, BBox, etc.)
│   ├── input/                          # Unified dual-input controller
│   │   ├── InputController.ts          # Keyboard + Gamepad API abstraction
│   │   └── GamepadMapper.ts            # Deadzone, deadband, axis normalization
│   ├── physics/                        # Hand-written vanilla physics
│   │   ├── PhysicsWorld.ts             # AABB sweep-and-prune broad phase
│   │   ├── CollisionResolver.ts        # Impulse-based resolution (no wrapper)
│   │   └── BroadPhase.ts               # Sweep & prune / spatial hash grid
│   ├── rendering/                      # Graphics pipeline
│   │   ├── PostProcessor.ts            # EffectComposer + UnrealBloomPass config
│   │   ├── BloomTuning.ts              # Emissive glow tuning (not wash-out)
│   │   └── RenderPipeline.ts           # Scene setup, camera rig, frustum culling
│   ├── vfx/                            # The 6 required shared VFX systems
│   │   ├── ParticleManager.ts          # Centralized pool, hard cap 500
│   │   ├── CameraShake.ts              # Trauma-based decay system
│   │   ├── HitStop.ts                  # Timescale dilation on heavy impacts
│   │   ├── MotionTrails.ts             # Trail renderer for fast movers
│   │   ├── ShockwaveRing.ts            # Expanding emissive ring mesh pool
│   │   └── FloatingScoreText.ts        # Dynamic 3D/HTML overlay score popups
│   ├── pooling/                        # Object pooling infrastructure
│   │   ├── Pool.ts                     # Generic T[] pool with borrow/return
│   │   ├── ProjectilePool.ts           # Bullet/ray pool
│   │   └── EntityPool.ts               # Enemy/particle entity pool
│   ├── generation/                     # 100% procedural asset generators
│   │   ├── GridGenerator.ts            # Retro-futurism floor/wireframe grid
│   │   ├── NeonEmitter.ts              # Glowing line/mesh emissive generators
│   │   ├── ProceduralTexture.ts        # Canvas API texture synthesis
│   │   └── GeometryDisplacer.ts        # Simplex/sine wave vertex displacement
│   ├── audio/                          # Web Audio API synthesized SFX/music
│   │   ├── AudioEngine.ts              # Master context, gain nodes, routing
│   │   ├── SynthSfx.ts                 # Oscillator-based impact/whoosh/explosion
│   │   └── SynthMusic.ts               # Procedural bassline/drone loop
│   ├── ui/                             # Glassmorphism HTML/CSS overlay system
│   │   ├── UiManager.ts                # HUD, menus, score, health bars
│   │   └── GlassPanel.ts               # Reusable glass panel component class
│   └── utils/                          # Cross-cutting utilities
│       ├── MathUtils.ts                # Quat slerp, lerp, distance, dot/cross
│       ├── Disposer.ts                 # Explicit .dispose() lifecycle tracker
│       └── Logger.ts                   # Timestamped debug logger (dev only)
│
├── game/                               # Each named game in its own isolated folder
│   └── <GAME_NAME>/                    # e.g. Asteroids/, Pac-Man/, etc.
│       ├── Game.ts                     # Entry: boot scene, register systems, start loop
│       ├── GameLogic.ts                # Core gameplay rules (win/loss, scoring)
│       ├── Entities.ts                 # Player, enemy, projectile entity classes
│       ├── Systems.ts                  # Game-specific system wiring
│       └── assets/                     # Procedural-only "assets" (all code-generated)
│           └── ...                     # (none — everything generated at runtime)
│
└── src/
    └── main.ts                         # Bootstraps Vite, mounts root div, starts @game/<name>/Game.ts
```
